action: Independently check stdi-3 and pin CONTEXT.md D8 (contract:brief-proof-only-for-cells) with behavior tests in the test module of herding/mailbox.rs. Cite an existing test that already covers a truth instead of duplicating it. State how each new test fails against the pre-stdi-3 code. Report a defect instead of rewriting stdi-3. Proof: the cell verify; quote the counts and test names. Rules for every cell: keep every rule and its why-clause (agents-block-diet D6); keep test-pinned wording unless this action names the pin; never add a size limit (D1). Write no code comments. Plain English, short sentences. Allowed bee commands: the cell verify, .bee/bin/bee knowledge check, .bee/bin/bee knowledge search. Do not run any bee dispatch or herding verb, not even its help. Run only the cell verify, never the full suite. Commit only the files of this cell, one commit, trailer cell: <id>.
